overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board lawfully chose to delegate response to an OML complaint to the Town Administrator rather than discuss its substance, and the complaint was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board violated the OML by delegating response to a Sept. 2 OML complaint to the Town Administrator without first discussing its substance.
allegations.key_passage: As we have previously explained to the Complainant on several occasions, that a public body may have chosen to refer a complaint rather than discuss its substance is the public body’s prerogative.
